card.name: Linking words before adverse-effect terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "including" and "with", and word parts inside cardiovascular or metabolic terms. It fires in warning and adverse-reaction passages just before a list of clinical effects.

modes.label: Linking word before effects
modes.description: A word like "of", "including" or "with" that leads into a named clinical sign or complication.
